description:
Skip the visits. Book your next home online.

Spotahome helps you browse thousands of verified apartments, studios, and rooms across Europe, with accurate photos, videos, and clear details—then book 100% online.

Pay securely, with deposit protection, and get support throughout the process. After check-in, you have a 24-hour window to confirm the home matches the listing.

A simpler way to rent remotely: clear info, safe payments, fewer surprises.

defaultPrompt: Furnished rentals in Barcelona for 3 months, move-in November
